```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(ROCR)
library(caret)


```

Loading file
```{r}
met_outcomes <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_outcomes.RData")
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData")
met_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_char.RData")

#note-some ages were censored for deindentification reasons
#if uncensored ages are needed for verification purposes
#please contact the corresponding author
```
Splitting by cohort and outcome

```{r}
source("../rf_functions.R")
```


#Creating objects for runs
```{r}
full_list <- colnames(met_data)[2:length(met_data)]
clin_list <- colnames(met_char)[2:length(met_char)]
bor_list <- c("PTPRC_3", "CEACAM1", "YWHAZ", "C10orf54", "CD27")
logr_list <- c("PTPRC_3")
greedy_list <- c("PTPRC_3", "CEACAM1")
#Unshuffled 
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
#Shuffled
run_number <- 1:1000
seed_list_r <- c(12345:13344)

nullmodel <- full_join(met_data, met_char)
null_list <- colnames(nullmodel)[2:length(nullmodel)]
```

#Met pro null model
```{r}
rf_prometa_nullmodel_random <- shuffled_rf(seed_list,
                                        "Therapy complete",
                                        "Progression",
                                        met_outcomes,
                                        nullmodel,
                                        "Met_Exp",
                                        "Met_Val",
                                        null_list
)



saveRDS(rf_prometa_nullmodel_random, file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_nullmodel_random.RData")

```



#Met pro greedy list
```{r}

 #running predictive model
 rf_prometa_greedy <- kTest(seed_list,
                     "Therapy complete",
                     "Progression",
                     "Model",
                     met_outcomes,
                     met_data,
                     "Met_Exp",
                     "Met_Val",
                     greedy_list)


saveRDS(rf_prometa_greedy, file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_greedy.RData")





rec.greedylist <- met.p.calc(rf_prometa_nullmodel_random,
                        "Progression",
                       rf_prometa_greedy)


metric_graph(rf_prometa_nullmodel_random,
             "Progression",
             rf_prometa_greedy)

```

#loading files
```{r}
rf_prometa_nullmodel_random <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_nullmodel_random.RData")
rf_prometa_clinical <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_clinical.RData")
rf_prometa_fullpanel <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_fullpanel.RData")
rf_prometa_boruta <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_boruta.RData")
rf_prometa_greedy <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_greedy.RData")
rf_prometa_logr <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_prometa_logr.RData")


```



#F1 graph
```{r}
f1.graph(rf_prometa_nullmodel_random,
         rf_prometa_clinical,
         rf_prometa_fullpanel,
         rf_prometa_boruta,
         rf_prometa_greedy, 
         rf_prometa_logr, 
         "Progression")

ggsave("../figures/rf_prometa_f1graph.png", width = 12, height = 5)

```



#MCC graph
